AnnoDesc: After escaping the gallows, you find more pressing matters await you than your own survival.
The "Bloodthirsty Siren" case is full of unanswered questions. In this mist, all you can do is keep searching for clues.
With sharp focus and insight, see through the darkness to the truth beneath it.
Following the rats' tracks, you search carefully for clues.
In the vast banquet hall, host and guests alike wear strange smiles.
In the mist between dream and reality, you seem trapped in a dream with no way out.
At the end of all madness and absurdity lies the final truth.
Beyond layers of mist and shadow, new secrets wait for those who dare to look.
Behind the sacred altar lie secrets from the past, too heavy to speak aloud.
In the chaos, darker currents stir, and prayers go unheard.
After escaping an unjust judgment, the next target emerges in the night.
Stand your ground in the dark, no matter what waits inside.
Across the endless "field" of the mind, unfamiliar flowers bloom.
Countless threads intertwine, blurring the line between truth and illusion.
Deep within the illusion of your mind, you touch countless fragments of the past.
After the shadows of the past are buried, new mysteries rise once more from the mist.
In the crevices of memory, the truth behind the case remains shrouded in ambiguity.
In the intangible, feel the binding force within the mist.
In an unfinished journey, there are always unknown doubts.
Within the ever-present shadows, an unseen gaze still lingers.
The past shatters like mirrors, yet it must not be forgotten.
Behind heavy curtains, old shadows refuse to fade.
Within forgotten memories, some things have never faded.
Between past and future, blind uncertainty entwines with longing.

AnnoName: The White Flower at the Corner
AnnoDesc: A single white flower offers an unexpected clue, drawing the buried history of Mistrellis Street back into the light.
Night deepens, but the trail is still warm. A black invitation lies waiting on the table.
The ball has descended into chaos, and the entire manor is searching for you. You need to slip away before they catch you.

AnnoName: At the Gates of the Forbidden Grounds
AnnoDesc: The forbidden grounds lie beyond the cemetery. At the fog wall, the list, the white flowers, and Nirvatia's old wounds all converge.
As the fog lifts, the streets stir back to life. There are still plenty of loose ends to tie up.
